title: laptop-vpn routes
description: Which sites go through the VPN, through Cisco, or straight out. Anything not listed goes through the VPN. Apply with: vpn apply

_guide.description: How to write this file. Kept up to date by `vpn` itself — edits here are overwritten.

rules.description: Your rules. Ctrl+Space inside the list inserts a new one.

defaultSnippets.label: New rule: domains
defaultSnippets.description: A group of sites and the way they go

defaultSnippets.label: New rule: Cisco, VPN without Cisco (like Claude)

name.description: A label for you; shown by `vpn routes` and `vpn check`.

enumDescriptions: Through our VPN (the default for anything not listed)
Through Cisco while it is connected; without Cisco, see without_cisco
Never through our VPN (while Cisco is connected, Cisco still carries it)
Our VPN — for sites that refuse Iranian IPs, like Claude
without_cisco.description: Only with "route": "cisco": where these sites go while Cisco is not connected.

enabled.description: false = this rule is off, without deleting it.

note.description: Free text, for you (JSON has no comments).

domains.description: "youtube.com" = it and all subdomains · "*.company.example" = only subdomains · "*.ir" or "ir" = every .ir domain. A full URL also works; it is cleaned to the name.

hosts.description: Exact names, not their subdomains: company machine names (corp-mgmt01), IP addresses, ranges (10.0.0.0/8).
